notes: Angels of Delusion: a full quirks-and-relationships pass. Sunna and Nangong elbow each other all the time, and Sunna wins every tussle (and gets her sheet music back) by tickling Nangong's stomach.

Dozens of canon quirks for each girl: Sunna's "I'm an apple" stage trick, her cafe uniform and embarrassing coffee spells, her airheaded mom; Nangong's calorie counting, "Tear Gland Insurance" and the secret pink helicopter; Aria's dead battery at a Bangboo charging station, cyber sheep and her three secret listeners (Lucy's boars).
Their ties to people outside the group: Tin Master, Astra Yao, Vesper, Lucy, Old Duyi, Enzo, Sunna's parents and more.
